subject: Our Maps
author: ZombieTron
body:
I am glad you like our maps, they are the culmination of a lot of work by Xandu and Evild, so although we are happy for you to add links to our site, we are not happy for you to copy them onto your own.

BurnoutAholics.com aim is to be the best resource for all Burnout games, all of the content on this site is created by us, or published with permission from other BurnoutAholics. We prefer to post links to the original information then to copy from other sources.

Thanks for your understanding,

ZombieTron
